params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} The rank of {{ai|Spider Form / Human Form|Elise}} affects the power of ''Spider Queen''.
params.blurb2: [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|'''Human Form'''|20px|link=Elise#Human Form|border]] Human Form: Whenever '''Elise's''' abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant ''Spiderling'', up to a cap.
params.blurb3: [[File:Spider_Form.png|'''Spider Form'''|20px|link=Elise#Spider Form|border]] Spider Form: '''Elise's ''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus ''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heal}} her.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Human Form:}} '''Elise''' gains one dormant ''Spiderling'' whenever she hits an enemy with an {{tip|ability}}, storing once per cast and up to {{pp|type = [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=]] ''Human Form's'' Rank|2 to 5 for 4}} at a time. She stores the maximum number of ''Spiderlings'' when the game starts and upon {{tip|death|respawning}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Spider Form:}} '''Elise's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{pp|type = [[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] Spider Form's Rank|14 to 44 for 4|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|type=[[File:Spider Form.png|20px|link=]] ''Spider Form's'' Rank|6 to 12 for 4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 8% AP)}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
params.notes:
* ''Spider Form's'' effects do not apply to {{tip|structures}}.
* If an ability hits while '''Elise''' is already in [[Elise#Spider Form / Human Form|Spider Form]], a ''Spiderling'' will spawn near her rather than being stored.
* The ''Spiderlings'' have a [[Pets#Leash ranges|leash range]].
* ''Spider Form's'' basic attacks will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the '''bonus''' damage does not).
** ''Spider Form's'' bonus damage and healing can be {{tip|blocked}}, {{tip|dodge}} and are not applied if '''Elise''' is {{tip|blind}}.
* Applies {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus magic damage on-hit in ''Spider Form''.
* The ''Spiderlings'' apply {{tip|area damage}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' {{tip|dash|pounces}} at the target enemy with her fangs and bites them, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{rutngt|0.5}} from the start of the cast time. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
params.description2: If there are active ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' or ''{{ai|Volatile Spiderling|Elise|Volatile Spiderlings}}'' nearby, they will {{tip|dash}} alongside '''Elise''' to the target upon ''Venomous Bite's'' cast and reprioritize them.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 170}} {{as|(+ 8% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''missing''' health)|health}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Elise''' will not dash if the target is within basic attack range.
** This ability is disabled while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}} even if '''Elise''' is in the range in which she does not dash.
* The dash and reveal take place from the start of the cast time.
* If '''Elise''' is allowed to dash, ''Venomous Bite'' can be used to cross sufficiently thin [[terrain]].
* {{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}} can cross walls and terrain to reach ''Venomous Bite's'' target and will attack provided '''Elise''' stays within their [[Pets#Leash range|leash range]].
** There is a maximum range in which ''Spiderlings'' or ''Volatile Spiderlings'' can dash to the target.
* {{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}} will dash even if they are {{tip|crowd control|crowd controlled}}.
* ''Venomous Bite'' will always apply its effects after the cast time, even if the dash is interrupted.
* ''Venomous Bite's'' {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} is a small area around the target, making it possible for them to exit the reveal radius and lose vision.
* ''Venomous Bite'' will still deal its damage but not apply on-hit effects if it is {{tip|blocked}} or {{tip|dodged}}. It cannot be missed while '''Elise''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
* With the exceptions of '''Elise's''' ''Death Blossom'', ''Victorious'', ''Blood Moon'', and ''Super Galaxy'' skins; ''Venomous Bite's'' VFX size will scale uncapped based off the total damage it does. {{bug|2}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Elise}} sends a ''Volatile Spiderling'' to the target location that chases down nearby enemies and explodes upon coming into contact with one or when it expires, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb3: If the ''Spiderling'' does not hit an enemy before then, it will chase down a nearby enemy.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' summons an {{tip|untargetable}} venom-gorged spider that lasts for 3 seconds. The spider searches for nearby targets and crawls to them after a delay of {{fd|0.75}} seconds and otherwise crawls to the target location before doing so without incurring a delay, navigating its path upon encountering terrain.
params.description2: The spider gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} based on its proximity to the detected target. When the spider comes into contact with an enemy, or upon expiring otherwise, it instantly explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description3: The spider prioritizes the nearest enemy if it detects one before reaching the target location, and {{tip|champion|champions}} always if it detects one after doing so.
params.notes:
* If ''Volatile Spiderling'' dashes to a target due to {{ai|Venomous Bite|Elise}}, it will not expire before finishing its jump.
** It can still collide with enemies while dashing, but since this proximity check is repeated only every so often, it might phase through an enemy on its way without detecting the collision if dashing quickly enough.
* The spiderling checks for nearby targets every {{rutngt|0.25}}, both for potential enemies to chase down and to explode 'on-contact'. Because of this, it may walk closer to an enemy than its "collision radius" before exploding.

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Elise}} and her ''Spiderlings'' {{tip|vanish}} into the air for a short time.

''Rappel'' can be recast on a target enemy within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration without a target.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Elise''' and her ''Spiderlings'' {{tip|blink|descend}} upon the target enemy, or their current position if there is no target.
params.blurb3: If ''Rappel'' is cast directly on a target enemy, she will automatically recast upon the target and {{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spider Queen's}} effects are increased for a few seconds.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' lift up into the air over {{fd|0.6}} seconds, immediately becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, and afterwards {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} for up to {{tt|{{fd|1.95}} seconds|Estimated}} and granting {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding {{tt|900 units|Pending for test}} for the duration.
params.description2: ''Rappel'' can be recast instantly on a target enemy within the duration, or without a target after {{tt|a delay|See notes}} for the duration, and does the latter automatically after the duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' reappear and descend onto the ground over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming targetable and able to act again afterwards. Additionally, ''{{ais|Spider Queen|Elise}}'' bonuses are increased for 5 seconds.
params.description4: If the recast was used on a target enemy, '''Elise''' and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' {{tip|blink|descend}} behind the target's location. Otherwise, she and her ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' will descend onto their current position without a target.
params.description5: ''Rappel's recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
params.target range: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|825|Location-targeted recast range, and recast range for descending onto targets with recast input (E2)}}|{{tip|er|icononly=true}} {{tt|900|Recast range for descending onto targets with attack commands (RMB)}}}}
params.outofrange:
If targeting a location with the first cast, walk in range of the target location to cast

If targeting an enemy with the first cast, walk in range of the target unit to cast

If targeting a unit or location with the second cast (recast), the ability will not cast
params.notes:
* When '''Elise''' casts ''Rappel'', a circle outlines the area in which a target can be selected to descend upon.
** '''Elise''' will always attempt to position behind her target at the same offset if she descends within than ''Rappel's'' max range (825), provided there is enough space at the other side. If the target is at the edge of the recast's radius, '''Elise''' will not appear at the exact offset behind her target but as close to them as possible instead.
*** For example, if the target's edge is barely within range for the recast, she will appear in front of them.
** If '''Elise's''' location-targeted recast is used by issuing a movement command within the respective range of ''Rappel'', she will descend as normal but then move to the location that the movement command was issued; her movement commands will not be interrupted from descending.
* The delay for recasting without a target after '''Elise''' has lifted into the air is inconsistent.{{bug}}
** The recast has a {{fd|0.33}}-seconds delay for issued movement commands, and a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay if the recast input itself is used.
* While '''Elise''' is lifting up into the air, she can buffer ''Rappel's'' recast by targeting an enemy with an attack command or the recast input itself in the meantime. She however cannot buffer ''Rappel's'' location-targeted recast.
** The initial cast can also directly target an enemy to buffer the recast.
** '''Elise''' will lift up into the air {{fd|0.05}} seconds shorter in this case.
* The bonuses granted for descending are not lost if '''Elise''' switches to ''Human Form''.
* ''Rappel'' can be cast on any targetable enemy unit ({{tip|champion|champions}}, {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|monster|monsters}}, {{tip|ward|wards}}, {{tip|stealthed trap|traps}}, and [[jungle plants]]) '''except''' [[structures]].
* If '''Elise''' is positioned within the radius of the unit she's using the initial target cast on, ''Rappel'' will instead register as a self-cast and not immediately descend. {{bug}}
* '''Elise''' can ''Rappel'' to {{ui|Rift Herald}} from the other side of the {{uis|Baron Nashor}} pit as well as to {{ui|Dragon}} by standing near the {{ui|Scryer's Bloom}} spawn locations. This is a result of {{tip|sight}} being granted in a smaller circle than the target range limit for descending and the {{tip|Summoner's Rift}} map having height variations.
* If '''Elise''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during ''Rappel'', she will descend back down immediately.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Elise''' is in ''Rappel'':
{{ct|attack=Descends onto the attack target.|move=Descends onto her current position.|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=death}}

blurb.plain:
Active: Elise and her Spiderlings vanish into the air for a short time. 
Rappel can be recast on a target enemy within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration without a target.

blurb2.plain: Recast: Elise and her Spiderlings descend upon the target enemy, or their current position if there is no target.

blurb3.plain: If Rappel is cast directly on a target enemy, she will automatically recast upon the target and Spider Queen effects are increased for a few seconds.

description.plain: Active: Elise and her Spider Queen lift up into the air over 0.6 seconds, immediately becoming untargetable and unable to act, and afterwards vanishing for up to 1.95 seconds and granting sight of the surrounding 900 units for the duration.

description2.plain: Rappel can be recast instantly on a target enemy within the duration, or without a target after a delay for the duration, and does the latter automatically after the duration.

description3.plain: Recast: Elise and her Spider Queen reappear and descend onto the ground over 0.4 seconds, becoming targetable and able to act again afterwards. Additionally, Spider Queen bonuses are increased for 5 seconds.

description4.plain: If the recast was used on a target enemy, Elise and her Spider Queen descend behind the target's location. Otherwise, she and her Spider Queen will descend onto their current position without a target.

description5.plain: Rappel's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

Recast range for descending onto targets with attack commands (RMB)

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} {{ci|Elise}} switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
params.blurb3:
{{sbc|Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, reducing her {{sti|attack range}} to {{tip|melee}}. She gains {{as|{{sti|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, new abilities, and a ''Spiderling'' swarm that will attack her foes.

{{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms back into {{tip|ranged|human}} form and stores her ''Spiderlings''.
params.blurb4: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'', which has 4 ranks.
params.description2: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Elise''' switches between her [[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Human Form}} and [[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] {{sbc|Spider Form}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|[[File:Spider_Form.png|20px|link=|border]] Spider Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a spider, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25 '''base''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|melee}} basic attacks with {{sti|125 range}}, and access to her arachnid abilities. Additionally, she summons all stored ''{{ai|Spider Queen|Elise|Spiderlings}}'' and {{tip|heals}} them to full health.
params.description4: {{sbc|[[File:Elise OriginalSquare.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Elise''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} basic attacks, and access to her human abilities. Additionally, she stores all active ''Spiderlings''.
params.description5: '''Elise''' begins with one rank in ''Spider Form / Human Form'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16.
params.notes:
*Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* If ''Spider Form'' is cast during a {{tip|attack windup|basic attack windup}}, '''Elise''' will perform a ''Spider Form'' basic attack that benefits from the bonus damage and healing from {{ai|Spider Queen|Elise}}, but remain at ''Human Form'' basic attack range, despite not using a projectile. This basic attack is considered a melee attack and thus will not trigger {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}'s {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts.
** ''Spider Form'' and ''Human Form'' have separate cooldowns.
